text:
Maya R: Putting this here — month-end mismatch for account AcmeCorp. Dashboard shows 0 tokens on "enterprise-standard" line but invoice includes 48,120 tokens. Filing as support escal.
Oliver H: @Maya can you paste the invoice line and the dashboard snapshot? :eyes: 
Maya R: invoice snippet: "ACME-ENT-2026-01, plan: enterprise-standard, tokens: 48120, amount: $241."
Maya R: dashboard snapshot: plan row exists but token column displays 0 for that account for 2026-01. I grabbed the UI export csv and attached (see below). CSV has plan_id=ent-std, tokens=0.
BillingBot: Scheduled meter run completed at 2026-02-01T01:05Z. Metering job id mtr-20260201-07 status=OK processed 392k usage events, backfilled=12 events.
Jing L: pinging metering infra — possible late backfill? @BillingBot do we have any backfill windows crossing month boundary?
BillingBot: Backfill window info: last_backfill=2026-02-01T01:07Z included events with event_ts=2026-01-31T23:59:58, source=embed-service, note="late flush".
Samir P: If backfill ran after invoice generation it could cause dashboard vs invoice swap but invoice included tokens, so weird.
Elaine C: I see two relevant jobs: daily-agg (runs at 00:30Z) and invoice-gen (runs at 02:00Z). If a backfill ran at 01:07Z it should be included in invoice. But dashboard cache refresh is at 04:00Z; that would reflect backfill as well. So why dashboard shows 0?
Oliver H: Could be UI-level filter mismatch — plan_id on invoice is "enterprise-standard" but dashboard might be using plan_code ent_std_old for legacy rows. @Maya can you share the CSV header and a couple rows?
Maya R: CSV header: account_id,plan_code,period_start,period_end,tokens,amount
Maya R: row: acme-001,ent-std-old,2026-01-01,2026-01-31,0,$0
Jing L: aha — plan_code mismatch. The invoice used normalized plan_code "enterprise-standard" mapping to ent-std-new. Metering->billing normalization might have applied during invoice gen but UI is pulling raw plan_code from events table.
Samir P: Quick repro SQL to check raw vs normalized:
```
SELECT e.account_id, e.plan_code as raw_code, b.plan_code as normalized_code, SUM(tokens) as tokens
FROM events e
LEFT JOIN billing_plan_map b ON e.plan_code = b.raw_code
WHERE period = '2026-01'
AND e.account_id = 'acme-001'
GROUP BY 1,2,3;
```
Oliver H: Run that and paste results.
Maya R: Ran it, output:
acme-001 | ent-std-old | enterprise-standard | 48120
acme-001 | ent-std-old | NULL | 0
Maya R: Looks like two rows — normalized_code present for metering->billing path but dashboard query is reading the raw row where normalized_code is NULL and tokens aggregated to 0 because different join path.
Elaine C: That indicates invoice pipeline applied the billing_plan_map earlier in the pipeline, but dashboard's query path didn't join the map correctly for legacy codings.
Jing L: Proposed fix: update dashboard ETL to join billing_plan_map and prefer normalized_code when present. Short term, we can patch the UI query to coalesce(normalized_code, raw_code) so it surfaces the invoice plan mapping.
Samir P: For immediate customer impact: generate a corrected dashboard CSV for AcmeCorp and send via support with apology. Also add a note explaining tokens are included in invoice; no overcharge.
Maya R: I will prepare the corrected CSV and notify Acme. Assigning to @Oliver for the ETL patch and to @Jing for follow-up on backfill logs and runbook.
Oliver H: Will open a PR to change dashboard query and schedule hotfix deploy today. ETA 4 hours.
BillingBot: Incident created: INC-20260201-43 "dashboard-plan-normalization-mismatch" severity=low owner=oliver-h
Elaine C: Add a postmortem section: root cause = inconsistent use of billing_plan_map in two paths; fix = ETL + add integration test; follow-up = scan for other accounts with ent-std-old codes.
Jing L: I'll run a quick scan: `SELECT DISTINCT account_id FROM events WHERE plan_code LIKE 'ent-std-%' AND period='2026-01';` will share results.
Maya R: Thanks team. I'll message AcmeCorp support channel with corrected numbers and include the invoice reference. :white_check_mark:
Oliver H: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/infra/dashboard/+/1234
Maya R: marking resolved for support tracking but leaving incident open until postmortem.
